name: pixel-heading-character

frames.best_why: The whole heading is crisp, its letters read as clearly different dot fonts, and the mode label shows.

tagline: Every letter sits in its own dotted, blocky typeface and keeps switching.
summary: A large display heading where each character is set in a different pixel font, the mix stepping through its faces on a timer so the word ripples and re-forms in new lettering.
appearance: A wide white heading on near-black, its glyphs built from dots, tiny squares and thin strokes so neighbouring letters look like different typefaces. Underneath sits a small uppercase label naming the current mode.
behaviour: Left alone in auto-play it keeps stepping each character to the next font on its own delay, so the change travels across the word like a ripple. Hovering or focusing restarts the cascade, and each letter is a separate span swapping a font class.
demo_content: The words "Ship Pixels" above Wave, Multi, Random and Uniform pills.
search_phrases: every letter in a different dot matrix font
heading that cycles typefaces letter by letter
blocky bitmap style title that animates
letters rippling through fonts on hover
dots and squares swapping in a headline
animated typographic headline for a landing page
how to give each character a different font
use_when: A short display headline should feel lo-fi and animated, with the type itself carrying the personality.
avoid_when: It needs five pixel web fonts registered, and the lettering only works at display size; body copy becomes hard to read.
customise: Pass the heading as children and choose mode, cycleInterval, staggerDelay, autoPlay and showLabel, plus a static prefix and an isolate map. The five faces are CSS classes.
weight_why: A line of spans and one timer that only changes class names.

a11y.note: The heading exposes its full text while each letter span is hidden, and Enter or Space advances it; motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: Everything depends on the five web fonts loading; without them the heading falls back to plain monospace.
polish_why: Tight, readable mixed-font title with a tidy mode label; the demo's pill buttons are plain.
title: Pixel Heading
